newsitem.title: USA: Campbell heir continues share sale.
newsitem.headline: Campbell heir continues share sale.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co said it was not involved in a 3.6 million share block trade executed on the NYSE minutes before Wednesday's market close.
Sources said the seller was John Dorrance III, a retired Campbell director and grandson of the company founder, who in recent months has been selling millions of shares of inherited Campbell stock.
Campbell said the block was not part of a share buyback program that it said it expects to begin Thursday under a three-year, $2.5 billion program announced in September.
Wednesaday's block trade was at 81 per share, off 1/4.
On October 31, Dorrance sold nine million Campbell shares at 80 per share.
